title: Product Definition
description: Definition of product under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: any article or goods or substance or raw material or any extended cycle of such product, which may be in gaseous, liquid, or solid state possessing intrinsic value which is capable of delivery either as wholly assembled or as a component part and is produced for introduction to trade or commerce, but does not include human tissues, blood, blood products and organs
content.plain_language: a good or substance that has value and can be sold or traded, either on its own or as part of something else
